references.text: Both verses document the critical transition where news of the brothers' arrival reaches Pharaoh, first as a rumor and then as an official report.
The verses show cause and effect, where the rumor in 45:16 is confirmed by Pharaoh's own statement in 47:5.
The verses connect the arrival of the rumor (45:16) with the formal presentation and details about the brothers' possessions (47:1).
Stephen's speech in Acts confirms and summarizes the historical event that Joseph's family became known to Pharaoh, which begins with the rumor in 45:16.
A deep theological parallel concerning God's hand granting favor among the Egyptians to save His people at two different moments in history.
The verses connect the news of the arrival (45:16) with the actual meeting and blessing of Pharaoh (47:7).
